summary: Two first checkouts at once each minted a provider customer; the second link insert hit the unique (user_id, provider) index, which ON CONFLICT (provider, external_id) did not cover, so the request failed with a 500 and left an orphaned customer. Fixed by inserting the link with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and reading back who holds what: the loser starts again under the winner's customer and both get the same checkout.
